grh_c1b48aeea3f741358d6f.title: The Stampede
paragraphs: On a cattle drive Britt rides with an older rancher and the man's younger brother Norm, whose inexperience has already created tension between them. The older brother finds an old love letter from his wife Carrie to Norm and assumes the two have betrayed him, then tries to kill Norm by deliberately setting off the herd in a narrow gorge. Norm risks his own life to save the brother who meant to kill him. As the older man lies mortally injured, Norm explains that Carrie's letter was written before she ever met her husband and that she had never loved Norm after the marriage; the brothers reconcile before the older man dies, and Norm helps Britt finish the drive.
